name: Allcargo Global Ltd
description: AboutAllcargo Global Ltd is the international supply chain arm of the Mumbai-based Allcargo Group, promoted by Shashi Kiran Shetty. It is an asset-light, digital-first NVOCC offering LCL consolidation, neutral FCL and neutral air freight globally under the ECU Worldwide brand, and is the world's largest LCL consolidator with a ~14-15% global share.The company was demerged from Allcargo Logistics Ltd under an NCLT-approved Composite Scheme of Arrangement (effective 01-Nov-2025) and listed on NSE and BSE on 03-Jul-2026.Key PointsDemerger & Group Structure:[1]The International Supply Chain businessof Allcargo Logistics was demerged intothe company under a composite scheme— appointed date 01-Oct-2023, NCLTapproval 10-Oct-2025, effective 01-Nov-2025, record date 12-Nov-2025. Shareholders received 1 share of AGL for every1 share of Allcargo Logistics; 98.28 Croreshares of ₹2 each were allotted. The same scheme merged ASCPL and GESCPL into Allcargo Gati and then Gati into Allcargo Logistics,
